meta.name: fluidsim
meta.description: Plan, configure, inspect, restart, and analyze bounded FluidSim computational-fluid-dynamics simulations with explicit numerical-validity and HPC safety checks. Use for FluidSim solver selection, parameter review, FFT/MPI setup, output diagnostics, or restart compatibility.

copy.tagline: 配置并校验计算流体仿真,让模拟稳定可靠、安全续跑
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在用计算流体仿真做科研数值模拟,需要确认设置准确并安全重启任务
copy.tagline_en: Set up and validate fluid-flow simulations for stable, safe runs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run computational fluid dynamics simulations and need sound setup and safe restarts

howto.what: Claude 会帮你用 Python 的 FluidSim 框架做流体模拟:挑选求解器、配置网格与物理参数、启动计算,并读取涡量场、能谱等输出结果。
howto.when: 当你要跑 2D/3D 纳维-斯托克斯、浅水方程等流体模拟,或需要审参数、配 FFT/MPI、做输出诊断与重启时,它会接手。

say.text: 把参数里的粘度 nu_2 改成 1e-3,顺便检查配置是否合法

howto.what_en: Claude helps you run fluid simulations with the Python FluidSim framework: picking a solver, setting grid and physical parameters, launching the run, and reading outputs such as vorticity fields and spectra.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to run 2D/3D Navier-Stokes or shallow-water simulations, review solver parameters, set up FFT/MPI, or inspect and restart output.
